# chainlaunch_connected_peers (Data Source)

Retrieve all connected peer nodes (remote Chainlaunch instances).

This data source returns a list of all peer-to-peer connections between Chainlaunch instances,
including connection IDs needed for network sharing operations.

**Use cases**:
- Get connection IDs for `chainlaunch_network_share` recipients
- List all peer-to-peer connections between Chainlaunch instances
- Monitor connection status across the consortium

**Prerequisites**:
- Pro features enabled on the Chainlaunch instance
- Peer connections established via `chainlaunch_node_invitation` and `chainlaunch_node_accept_invitation`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connected_peers` (Attributes List) List of connected peer nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connected_peers))

<a id="nestedatt--connected_peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connected_peers`

Read-Only:

- `analytics_enabled` (Boolean) Whether analytics sharing is enabled for this connection
- `connected_at` (String) Timestamp when the connection was established
- `id` (Number) Connection ID. Use this ID as recipient in `chainlaunch_network_share`.
- `metrics_federation` (Boolean) Whether metrics federation is enabled for this connection
- `node_id` (String) Remote node's unique identifier
- `peer_endpoint` (String) Remote node's endpoint URL
- `peer_public_key` (String) Remote node's public key for secure communication
- `status` (String) Connection status (e.g., 'connected', 'disconnected')
